questions.question:
In the following question, select the related word pair from the given alternatives.

Police : Criminals : : ? : ?
questions.solution:
The Police is related to Criminals, in the same way Doctor is related to Patients.

Hence, “Doctor : Patient” is the related word pair among the given alternatives.

questions.question: In the following question, select the odd word pair from the given alternatives.
questions.solution:
Cow is an animal. Peacock is a bird. Chair is a furniture. However, Planet is not Venus. The analogy is in reverse order in this pair.

Hence, Planet : Venus is the odd word pair among the given alternatives.

questions.question: In the following question, four number pairs are given. The number on left side of (-) is related to the number of the right side of (-) with some Logic/Rule/Relation. Three are similar on basis of same Logic/Rule/Relation. Select the odd one out from the given alternatives.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

(11 - 1)² = 100

(13 - 1)² = 144

(19 - 1)² = 324

(17 - 1)² = 256 ≠ 246

Hence, 17 - 246 is the odd number pair among the given alternatives.

questions.question: Present ages of Rahul and his brother are in the ratio of 5 : 3. After 4 years ratio of ages of Rahul’s brother and his sister will be 5 : 6. If the present age of his sister is 26 years, then what will be the age (in years) of Rahul 3 years from now?
questions.solution:
Present age of Rahul and his brother = 5 : 3 → 5x : 3x

After 4 years ratio of Rahul’s brother and his sister: 3x + 4 : sister’s age : : 5 : 6.

Present age of his sister is 26 years. After 4 years her age will be 30 years

frac{{3x + 4}}{{sister's age after 4 years }} = (5)/(6)

frac{{3x + 4}}{{30 }} = (5)/(6) =

3x + 4 = frac{{5 times 30}}{6} = 25

3x = 21; x =7

Present age of Rahul = 5x = 5 × 7 = 35

After 3 years his age will be 35 + 3 = 38 years.

Hence, the age (in years) of Rahul 3 years from now will be 38 years.

questions.question:
From the given alternatives, select the word which CANNOT be formed using the letters of the given word.

Responsibility
questions.solution:
1) Ability → Responsi**bility** : this word cannot be formed as there is no A in Responsibility.

2) Pen → R**e**s**p**o**n**sibility

3) Nose → R**e**sp**ons**ibility

4) Possible → R**espo**n**sib**i**l**ity

Hence, “Ability” word cannot be formed from the given word.

questions.question:
In the question two statements are given, followed by two conclusions, I and II. You have to consider the statements to be true even if it seems to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the given conclusions, if any, follows from the given statements.

**Statement I:** Some roses are flowers

**Statement II:** Some red are roses

**Conclusion I:** Some flowers are red

**Conclusion II:** All red are flowers

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be6d42792db0a3e4f3e61ec1c60f6e953e86929f384bef9952e618f57cd0a1f0.png] 

**Conclusion I:** Some flowers are red → False (It is possible but not definite)

**Conclusion II:** All red are flowers → False (It is possible but not definite)

Hence, neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows
